shortDescription: Vancouver, British Columbia, Oct. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Global Power Solutions Corp. CSE:PWER FSE:NJA (“Global Power” or the “Company”) today provides an update regarding its ongoing evaluation of opportunities within the evolving power infrastructure and data-centre markets.Global Power is…

children: ”) today provides an update regarding its ongoing evaluation of opportunities within the evolving power infrastructure and data-centre markets.

Global Power is evaluating a range of potential power-generation and infrastructure solutions that may complement the Company’s long-term strategy. The Company is considering opportunities across multiple technologies and deployment models, with a particular focus on solutions capable of supporting data centres, high-performance computing, industrial operations and other mission-critical applications.

Global Power believes the rapidly changing power landscape presents significant opportunities for innovative, flexible and scalable power solutions. Accordingly, the Company intends to remain flexible in evaluating strategic alternatives and potential technology partners as it determines the most commercially viable path forward.

The Company’s evaluation may include conventional and emerging power-generation technologies, distributed and modular power infrastructure, energy-storage solutions, hydrogen-related applications, and other technologies capable of addressing the increasing demand for reliable power in constrained grid environments.

There can be no assurance that the Company’s evaluation will result in any particular transaction, partnership, technology deployment or investment. Global Power will provide further updates as appropriate and when material developments occur.

In addition, the Company announces that it has provided notice to terminate its previously announced definitive joint development and licence agreement with Northern Hydrogen and Energy Ltd., with acknowledgment and consent from ModeOne Manpower Systems Corp. and MVP Systems. The Company also announces that it has terminated its previously announced non-binding letter of intent with 2782404 AB Ltd. The termination of the definitive joint development and licence agreement is effective November 7, 2026, and the termination of the non-binding letter of intent is effective immediately.

Global Power Solutions Corp. is focused on the development and deployment of innovative power and infrastructure solutions designed to address the growing demand for reliable, scalable and resilient energy. The Company is evaluating opportunities serving data centres, high-performance computing, industrial, commercial and other mission-critical applications across North America.
